title: Sun visor side coverage and mirror lighting
summary: Feedback centers on sun visor side-window coverage, fit around adjacent components, and vanity mirror lighting, but most examples are too fragmentary to classify beyond mentioning these areas.

positive.summary: One positive-coded review mentions the driver-side sun visor mirror light being too dim for use, so the sample does not provide a clear positive aspect.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the visor being too short for side coverage, collisions with the headrest, uncovered glare at the side window, dim vanity mirror lighting, and unclear behavior when shut firmly or compared with demo cars.

limitations: Most sample fragments are labeled undetermined, limiting confident sentiment interpretation.
The positive-coded example contains complaint-like wording, so sentiment labels and fragment text appear misaligned.
Several fragments are incomplete or context-poor, especially the references to comparing demo cars and snapping the visor shut firmly.
This topic mixes multiple visor-related subissues, including side coverage, headrest interference, and mirror illumination, rather than one clearly coherent problem.
